jobs.occupation: Lead Mechanical Design Engineer, Power Electronics (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: What to ExpectPlease not: roles are open at multiple seniority levels for demonstrated excellence.At Tesla Engineering Germany in Freiburg, we're building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. You will own the cradle-to-grave mechanical design of tightly integrated, high-volume electromechanical systems, from first concept through prototyping and validation to mass production. You'll work closely with Electrical, Product, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams. This is an opportunity to own key projects, use modern tools, and work in state-of-the-art facilities on power electronics that ship in Tesla products worldwide. Your work contributes directly to the world's transition to sustainable energy. At the lead level, you will also set technical direction and guide a small team of mechanical engineers.What You’ll Do- Own the electromechanical design of injection-molded plastics, sheet metal, high-pressure die castings, heat sinks / cold plates, insulation systems, magnetics, HV/LV interconnects, busbars, and PCBA-adjacent structures- Solve electronics packaging end-to-end: thermal management, high-voltage insulation (creepage/clearance), IP67+ sealing, EMI, shock/vibration, and long-term environmental reliability- Lead track: Serve as technical owner of a product line, mentor 3–4+ engineers, lead and approve design reviews, and enforce technical rigor and schedule discipline- Analyze before you cut metal: thermal / CFD, structural FEA, tolerance stacks, DFM / DFA / DFR, and DFMEA where it matters- Design custom magnetics and power interfaces (inductors, transformers, chokes, terminals) as first-class mechanical products, not afterthoughts- Partner with electrical, systems, reliability, manufacturing, supply chain, and compliance teams, and design against UL / IEC / GB standards through to certification- Drive prototypes into reality: builds, test support, characterization, design verification, and root-cause analysis of failures- Release for production in CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE: 3D models, 2D drawings with GD&T, PLM / ECOs / BOMs, and supplier collaboration for automated manufacturing at thousands of units per weekWhat You’ll Bring- Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience; Master’s degree preferred for senior/ staff/ lead level- Strong mechanical fundamentals and a physics-based, first-principles approach to structural and thermal problems- Proven product design ownership from concept to scaled production (portfolio preferred)- Lead track: 7+ years of relevant product design experience, including 2+ years of design leadership- Fluency in CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE, GD&T, tolerance analysis, and design for high-volume processes (molding, stamping, die casting, fastening, joining, dispensing)- Ability to run, or critically review, thermal / CFD / structural analysis, plus working knowledge of power electronics components (PCBAs, MOSFETs, inductors, transformers)- Detail-oriented, with clear written and verbal communication in English and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment Highly valued:- Direct experience in power electronics packaging: inverters, chargers, DC-DC, magnetics, busbars, or HV semiconductor modules- Experience designing against certification standards (UL, IEC, GB) and obtaining certificates- Multiphysics intuition: heat transfer, fluids, mechanics, and materials (magnetics a strong plus)- MATLAB / Python for data reduction, scripting, or reduced-order thermal models- PLM / change control / BOM discipline in a fast-moving product environment- Hands-on lab instinct: you would rather instrument a prototype than argue from a slideTesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. jobs.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced Distribution Partner Development Manager to own and drive the AWS distribution strategy across Germany. In this role, you will manage and grow strategic relationships with our Authorised Distribution Partners such as Ingram Micro and TD Synnex, particularly for SMB and Enterprise customers. An additional area of responsibility is to grow the business with large value added resellers (“Systemhäuser”, e.g. Bechtle, Cancom) across Enterprise and Public Sector Accounts.The AWS Distribution Program enables our distributors to act as force multipliers — leveraging their deep partner relationships, market knowledge, and specialised expertise to extend the reach of AWS solutions to customers we cannot efficiently serve through direct channels alone. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that requires a rare blend of strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and operational discipline. You will not only execute on strategy — you will shape it, acting as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions and influencing worldwide policy decisions where distribution-specific considerations are required.As the single-threaded owner of the German distribution channel, you will serve as the primary interface between AWS and our distributors, driving incremental revenue through their reseller communities. You will work cross-functionally with AWS sales, partner, marketing, and solutions architecture teams to accelerate cloud adoption at scale, particularly within the SMB Commercial Sector.Key job responsibilitiesPartner Management & Strategy• Own end-to-end relationships with Authorised Distribution and Systemhaus Partners in Germany.• Develop and execute joint business plans aligned to AWS go-to-market and EMEA strategy.• Drive QBRs and cadence meetings with partner leadership at VP/CXO level.• Grow distributor-attributed and AWS Marketplace revenue YoY.• Pursue new routes-to-market and "Power of Three" collaboration.Revenue & Performance Management• Own revenue targets for the German channel, including resell and influenced revenue.• Monitor distributor performance: revenue, recruitment, enablement, pipeline.• Produce monthly partner reports from internal dashboards.• Analyse trends, flag risks/opportunities, drive action plans.• Track Partner Attributed Revenue and ensure accurate attribution.Program Design & Execution• Act as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions, representing field-level feedback on attribution models, incentive structures, and partner programs..• Ensure distributors are enabled on launches and policy changes.Enablement & Ecosystem Growth• Recruit, onboard, and activate new resellers into the channel.• Align with PDMs and Account Managers across direct, distribution, and "Power of Three" motions.• Drive technical enablement (AI, Migration, Data & Analytics); support co-sell/co-marketing.Cross-Functional Collaboration• Align Germany execution with EMEA Scale & Distribution strategy.• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Partner Solutions Architects, Operations.About the teamThe Distribution team sits within the Amazon Partner Organisation in Germany & Europe Central, focused on extending AWS's reach through established distributor communities to serve the Commercial Sector at scale. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-performing team that values customer obsession, partner obsession, and execution excellence.Basic Qualifications- Bachelor's degree- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences- Minimum 6 years of channel experience, with specific distribution, indirect channel or reselling background- German and English business fluent- Cloud and/or digital transformation experience — understanding of cloud business models, consumption economics, and partner ecosystems- Proven ability to manage breadth over depth — portfolio management across 30+ partners through leverage and prioritisation- Strong commercial acumen: pipeline management, forecasting, and revenue accountability- Demonstrated stakeholder management across complex, matrixed organisationsPreferred Qualifications- Direct experience with IT distribution (Ingram Micro, TD SYNNEX, Arrow, ALSO) or Systemhaus channel (Bechtle, Cancom, Computacenter)- AWS or hyperscaler partner programme experience- Experience with CRM systems and pipeline analytics (Salesforce preferred)- Understanding of software marketplace transaction models and cloud procurement- Track record of building new coverage models or channel motions from scratch- Familiarity with German SMB and mid-market IT landscapeAmazon is an equal opportunities employer.
